meta.title: Student Hostel
meta.description: Student hostel at XLRI Delhi-NCR: furnished rooms in a fully residential campus, with a gym in the hostel and the mess, laundry and store close by.

title: Student Hostel
intro: All programmes at XLRI are residential, so the hostel is home for the length of the course — a furnished room of your own, with the gym, the mess and everyday services a short walk away.

photos.alt: A hostel room with a bed, study desk and chair, and a wardrobe by the window
A hostel room with a single bed, wardrobe and shelves
The academic and hostel blocks of the XLRI Delhi-NCR campus across the lawn

highlights.title: Furnished rooms
highlights.text: Each room comes with a bed, a study desk and chair, a wardrobe and shelves.

highlights.title: A gym in the hostel
highlights.text: In the hostel itself there is a large gym available for all students to use.

highlights.title: A residential community
highlights.text: Seniors and juniors live on the same campus, and the XL culture grows out of that closely knit community.

related.label: Food Courts
related.description: A 24×7 cafeteria, The Daily Spot, the mess and NESCAFE Break Zone.

related.label: Laundry Facilities
related.description: Washing, ironing and dry cleaning for students.

related.label: Daily Needs Store
related.description: Fresh produce, groceries and personal care on campus.
